edits.old: The documented context.http client makes outbound requests asynchronously. Its response body is BSON.Binary; response.body.text() decodes it before JSON.parse or EJSON.parse handles JSON. Parse only when the response payload is actually JSON. (high confidence)
edits.new: The documented context.http client is a built-in client for sending HTTPS requests, and its methods are awaited in async Functions (for example, await context.http.get(...)).
